description: Deterministic rendering of publication-ready tables and figures from already-produced machine-readable scientific artifacts (model_registry / estimates / diagnostics / data_manifest). It must NOT define or recompute scientific estimands; tables/figures are derived views and must preserve provenance back to the source artifact. Formatting choices must not change scientific conclusions.

methodology.note: Observed practice: real projects render tables/figures as a deterministic step (niger-asp report_tables/graphs; euro-scm 4_ComparisonTables / 5_Graphs -> Output; learning-poverty 03_export_tables / 05_working_paper). Workflow/template precedent: journal-skills 09_tables.do + aejmac-tables-figures. Institutional guidance: src-aea-style (presentation only). Our engineering abstraction: artifact-only deterministic rendering — scientific numbers must come from upstream machine-readable artifacts, tables/figures are derived views, presentation must not add a new numerical source of truth, and rendering must preserve provenance back to the source artifact.
